rationale: Allowed next actions express user-facing requirements before running the comparison. They are not generated from model scores. Each case starts from the same two-page knowledge slice and a two-minute budget.

cases.requirement: No history: either available page is a valid starting point.
After sustained reading of A, offer new material B without asking for confirmation.
When A is already familiar, give B priority without fabricating objective verification.
A reported difficulty with B should surface B before unrelated A.
After reporting difficulty with A and revisiting it, allow onward reading B without another declaration.
Answer citations alone must not retire A or demand an already-known declaration.
